dog.description_text:
Manny is a sweet, playful boy who has really made himself at home in foster care! He loves watching the world go by from his favorite window, chasing his toys, and stretching out on the couch like he owns the place. When he’s not busy entertaining himself, you’ll often find him curled up in bed with his foster family. He’s become quite the affectionate companion and loves being close to his people.

Manny is on a special diet for urinary health and prefers to graze throughout the day, enjoying his meals at his own pace. He’s looking for a loving home where he can keep enjoying his favorite things: playtime, window watching, and plenty of snuggles!

If this animal is located at our Manhattan Adoption Center, head in to meet them and see if you are a match! We are a same-day adoption center, and an application does not put you on a list or hold an animal for you. If they are in Wantagh or in a foster home, please submit an online application and our team will reach out to further discuss the adoption process. Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped, and given their age-appropriate vaccines.
